channel.description: Storytime, youth programs, and all-ages activities — plus upcoming government meetings and comment deadlines.

item.title: [Meeting] Lodging Tax Board 06/18/26 — 2026-06-18
item.description:
San Miguel County • 2026-06-18
The Lodging Tax Board meets to review tax reports and hear updates from the Norwood Chamber and Telluride Tourism Board. Standard quarterly check-in on how lodging tax dollars are being distributed and used across the county.

item.title: [Thu, Jun 18] Storytime / Hora de Cuentos
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Lower Terrace - outdoors 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM · English stories, songs, rhymes and fun for children of all ages and their parents or caregivers. Cuentos, canciones, rimas y diversión en inglés para niños de todas las edades y sus padres o cuidadores.

item.title: [Thu, Jun 18] Family Lego Competition!
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Lower Terrace - outdoors 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM · *PLEASE DO NOT REGISTER EACH INDIVIDUAL MEMBER OF YOUR FAMILY. ONLY ONE NAME IS REQUIRED TO SIGN UP YOUR FAMILY* Gather your team (family) and join us on the patio for some friendly competition! Each family will be given the same Lego set. Prizes for the top three speeds! All families will get to keep their Lego set. Register on the website. Space and Lego sets are limited.

item.title: [Thu, Jun 18] Littles On the Move
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Program Room 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Join us at this inclusive and welcoming playgroup for children ages 0-3 and their grownups. We have tunnels, a ball pit, instruments, and sensory activities. Únase a nosotros en este grupo de juego inclusivo y acogedor para niños de 0 a 3 años y sus adultos. Habrá túneles, piscina de bolas, instrumentos y actividades sensoriales.

item.title: [Fri, Jun 19] Up-off Gymnastics, Dance, and Spanish
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Lone Cone Library Norwood We are a MOBILE family business offering non-competitive Gymnastics, Preschool Spanish, & Dance classes to the San Miguel County area. Tia Uphoff was a competitive gymnast and an instructor for 20+ years, helping children develop balance, flexibility, strength and proper tumbling techniques while using positive reinforcement and encouragement for success. Infant to Age 5 — Padres & Pequenos Class – $10.00 per class This class invites adults & kids to participate in Educational songs, in English & Spanish, with intro to gymnastics. Sign up at any time and get started weekly. Fridays — 11:15-11:40 am @ Lone Cone Library Norwood K to 3rd Grade week Session 8 Week Winter Session $150 for the 8 sessions. Thursdays – 430-530 pm @ Lone Cone Library Norwood For more information and to register: Contact Tia @ liv2danz247@gmail.com or find us on Facebook!
